Select: chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
